status: prospective contract only; no new runner or passing equivalence receipt
authority: E holds expectations and compares; isolated U runs all submitted functions/tests/config/hooks. U has no expectations, E/C/N state, service, credentials or network; sealed submission read-only, ephemeral scratch.
order: Original scenario.cases array order; unchanged name/tags/count; send one current case input only after previous result. Do not send expected values or all cases.
module_lifetime: One fresh isolated Node process per scenario/submission; cache ES modules across its ordered cases as original import URLs do. No restart per call; crash/timeout ends that process and remaining cases fail, with explicit reasons.
input: file/export plus args, or command argv and records, per frozen case; no expected/throws/tag/pass fields to U
return: one length-framed JSON value or {throw:{name,message}} on private result channel; stdout/stderr separate untrusted captures; no pass boolean accepted
equality: E applies isDeepStrictEqual to JSON-normalized return (JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value))) and frozen equals. Serialization exception/undefined/cycle/BigInt is a failed case. No coercion, sorting, numeric tolerance or trimming.
throws: For expects.throws compare exact name AND message. Did-not-throw fails; unexpected throw fails. Hostile exception access/serialization failure is failure, never comparator authority.
commands: Capture ordered out/err callback arguments and return code; compare {code,out,err} exactly against frozen expect with isDeepStrictEqual in E. Require JSON-compatible values; non-JSON loses transport fidelity and explicitly fails (prospective amendment). Process stdout is not callback output.
failure: Timeout/crash/limit breach/oversize/malformed/duplicate/unframed output is a failed case; crash/timeout/limit breach terminates U and all remaining cases fail with reason. E failure or unproven isolation is V4-instrument, not a product failure. Missing export fails. No silent retries/restarts.
visible_tests: Worker-authored test/config/hook code during integration and verification uses U identity/profile too; retain separate terminal/capture. Visible test status is not hidden acceptance. Integration git hooks disabled; never execute worker config under E/C/N.

equivalence_matrix.required: Compare each named case/tag with original runner on trusted fixtures only: amended all pass; original D0 fails D1 subset; baseline and each constant mutant fail as before. Retain old runner hash separately.

runner_source_unavailable_reason: No v4 runner authored in method draft. D3 must bind separately reviewed actual runner/decoder bytes; D2/D5 require equivalence and hostile-code controls. This draft is not execution-ready.
